calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) dist_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, sum(closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-28' AND DATE '2026-08-09' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, s.store_name, fs.closing_units, fs.closing_value, p.standard_unit_cost,
         fs.product_key, fs.store_key
  FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT week_ending_date, category = 'Paint & Decorating' AS pd,
  count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (store_id, sku)) dist_nat, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores,
  min(store_id) mnst, max(store_id) mxst,
  sum(closing_units) units, sum(closing_value) val,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(closing_value - closing_units*standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg
FROM r WHERE category IN ('Paint & Decorating') OR category='ZZ Test' OR true
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.is_current, s.close_date, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, count(*) rows_pd, sum(fs.closing_units) u, sum(fs.closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND p.category='Paint & Decorating'
  AND (s.store_id IN (125,129,104,119,136,137) OR s.store_id>=900 OR s.close_date IS NOT NULL OR NOT s.is_current)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
         SUM(fs.closing_value) FILTER (WHERE cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating') AS asis_value,
         SUM(fs.closing_value) FILTER (WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating') AS aswas_value,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.sku IS NULL) AS no_current_version
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) weeks, MIN(week_ending_date) first_w, MAX(week_ending_date) last_w,
       ROUND(AVG(asis_value), 2) avg_asis, ROUND(AVG(aswas_value), 2) avg_aswas, SUM(no_current_version) nocur
FROM weekly
